fields.explanation: The original thin category 0<1 is Mathlib Bool with its preorder category. F has the required terminal domain and selects true (1). The declared input category is CostructuredArrow (identity) true, the printed input label is StructuredArrow true F, and the target is Comma (identity) F. The original x=(false,*,false→true) is kept. Every printed-domain input indexes only an object with left object true, so neither x nor its identity has a supplied clause. Correcting the domain labels gives an actual identity functor on the standard comma presentation. This certifies the literal incomplete definition, not falsity of the intended slice-category isomorphism.
fields.flaw: The displayed clauses define a functor I_2 from (id_C ↓ C) to (id_C ↓ F).
fields.problem:
Title: Slice Category is Isomorphic to Identity Functor Over Object Comma Category

Let $\mathbf C$ be a [[Definition:Category|category]].

Let $C$ be an [[Definition:Object (Category Theory)|object]] of $\mathbf C$.

Let $\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C}$ denote the [[Definition:Identity Functor|identity functor]] on $\mathbf C$.

Let $\mathbf C / C$ denote the [[Definition:Slice Category|slice category]] $\mathbf C$ over $C$.

Let $\paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C}$ denote the [[Definition:Functor Over Object Comma Category|comma category]] $\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C}$ over $C$.

Then:
:$\mathbf C / C \cong \paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C}$

with [[Definition:Isomorphism of Categories|isomorphisms of categories]]:
:$I: \mathbf C / C \to \paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C}$ defined by:
{{DefineFunctor
|ob = for each [[Definition:Object (Category Theory)|object]] $g$ in $\mathbf C / C$:
:$I g = \tuple {\operatorname {dom} g, g}$
|mor = for each [[Definition:Morphism (Category Theory)|morphism]] $k: g \to g'$ in $\mathbf C / C$:
:$I k = k$
}}
::as per [[Definition:Commutative Diagram|commutative diagrams]]:

::<nowiki>$\begin{xy}
<0em,8em>*+{\mathbf C / C} ="ID",
<21em,8em>*+{\paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C} } ="IC",

<6em,2em> ="ID",
<10em,2em> ="IC",

"ID";"IC" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/_1em/{I},

<-3em,4em>*+{E} = "E",
<3em,4em>*+{E'} = "E2",
<0em,0em>*+{C} = "C",

"E";"E2" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?*!/_1em/{k},
"E";"C" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.3)*!/^1em/{g},
"E2";"C" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.3)*!/_1em/{g'},

<15em,4em>*+{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} E = E} = "GE",
<27em,4em>*+{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} E' = E'} = "GE2",
<21em,0em>*+{C} = "C",

"GE";"GE2" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/_1em/{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} k = k},
"GE";"C" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/^1em/{g},
"GE2";"C" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/_1em/{g'},
\end{xy}$</nowiki>

and:
:$J: \paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C} \to \mathbf C / C$ defined by:
{{DefineFunctor
|ob = for each [[Definition:Object (Category Theory)|object]] $\tuple {E, g}$ in $\paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C}$:
:$J \tuple {E, g} = g$
|mor = for each [[Definition:Morphism (Category Theory)|morphism]] $k: \tuple {E, g} \to \tuple {E', g'}$ in $\paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C}$:
:$J k = k$
}}

::<nowiki>$\begin{xy}
<3em,8em>*+{\paren {\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow C} } ="GC",
<24em,8em>*+{\mathbf C / C} ="GF",

<14em,2em> ="ID",
<18em,2em> ="IC",

"ID";"IC" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/_1em/{J},

<-3em,4em>*+{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} E = E} = "GE",
<9em,4em>*+{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} E' = E'} = "GE2",
<3em,0em>*+{C} = "C",

"GE";"GE2" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/_1em/{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} k = k},
"GE";"C" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/^1em/{g},
"GE2";"C" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.5)*!/_1em/{g'},

<21em,4em>*+{E} = "E",
<27em,4em>*+{E'} = "E2",
<24em,0em>*+{C} = "C",

"E";"E2" **@{-} ?>*@{>}  ?*!/_1em/{k},
"E";"C" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?*!/^.6em/{g},
"E2";"C" **@{-} ?>*@{>} ?<>(.6)*!/_1em/{g'},
\end{xy}$</nowiki>

fields.witness: Let 𝓒 be the thin category 0<1, let 𝓓 and 𝟙 be terminal, let F:𝓓→𝓒 select 1, and let C:𝟙→𝓒 also select 1. In (id_𝓒↓C), x=(0,⋆,u:0→1) is an object. But (C↓F) has only (⋆,⋆,id₁), so the displayed object clause, quantified only over (C↓F), assigns no value to x.

scope_metadata.final_theorem_status: Not challenged: the slice/comma isomorphism is true; only the mislabelled, incomplete printed definition is refuted. Misprint-level item, not a mathematical source error and not a false category-equivalence theorem.
